head_commit.message:
Add conditional turn interruption that preserves pending input (#47340)

## Why

Callers need to interrupt a specific active turn without discarding queued input. Tool callbacks must be able to await the interruption decision without blocking task cancellation.

## What changed

- Add `CodexThread::interrupt_if_no_pending_input` and `Op::InterruptIfNoPendingInput`.
- Check the turn identity and pending user input or mailbox items before taking the active task. Leave the turn running for stale or abandoned requests.
- Acknowledge the decision before joining cancellation, and unblock pending submissions when the active task is cancelled.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for successful interruption, stale turns, preservation of queued user input and agent mail, abandoned requests, and cancellation while the submission queue is full.

GitOrigin-RevId: 42e31c09369fb070ba1b4b3c64ef45334dd872d8

head_commit.message:
Move the activity inspection hint into keyboard shortcut help (#47338)

## What changed

- Add “Inspect activity” to the shortcut help’s Session section, using the runtime `focus_activity` binding (`F4` by default) and hiding it when unbound.
- Remove the passive activity footer hint so composer hints remain available. Keep previous, next, details, and back controls while activity is focused, shortening them to fit the available width.

## Testing

Add snapshot coverage for default, remapped, and disabled activity shortcuts. Update footer coverage to verify the absence of passive hints and interactive controls at 20, 32, and 80 columns.

## New Features

- Choose an optional fullscreen UI with `/tui` for your next launch, including transcript search, mouse selection, and right-click copying. (#46732, #46734, #46883, #46895)
- Voice conversations are enabled by default, with an F8 toggle, a `/voice settings` picker, and bundled audio runtimes for Linux and Windows. (#44921, #46071, #44622, #44714, #44922)
- Explore account usage, token totals, and plugin and skill activity through the `/usage` analytics dashboard. (#45764, #45769)
- Filter tasks by status and create worktree sessions from the agent command center; worktree support is now enabled by default. (#46839, #45276, #44870)
- Customize the terminal with six new themes and view supported Mermaid diagrams and display equations directly in responses. (#46504, #46054, #45612)
- Update the local background server through `/daemon`, or bypass it with `--no-daemon`. (#45854, #46088)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserve streamed answers and plans when turns fail, are interrupted, or receive subagent completion events. (#45549, #46867)
- Fix clipboard forwarding in tmux and SSH sessions and preserve tab indentation when terminals send pasted text as individual keystrokes. (#45457, #45454)
- Restore Plan mode when resuming sessions and preserve thread identity and settings when editing earlier prompts. (#45519, #45845)
- Recover login through system proxies and refresh MCP credentials when OAuth discovery returns a 503 error. (#46562, #44636)
- Prevent speech from being dropped during playback pauses or bursts of incoming audio. (#46880)
- Close sandbox isolation gaps involving inbound Windows connections, privileged Linux/macOS sockets, and writes through read-only macOS file handles. (#44639, #45984, #46500)

## Documentation

- Clarify that deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` personality settings no longer select response styles. (#45809)
- Explain how `?` matches a single character in network proxy allow and deny patterns. (#46027)

## Chores

- Update bundled TLS dependencies, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 for Linux musl builds. (#45149, #45489)

head_commit.message:
Avoid redundant spacing above the transcript composer (#47331)

## Why

An empty composer hint row already separates activity from the input. Adding another separator wastes transcript space, especially in short terminals.

## What changed

Reserve the extra separator only when copy status text, a follow control, or a fitting hint occupies the shared row and the viewport has room. Recalculate the transcript layout in the same frame when adding that separator, and use a shared timestamp for copy status visibility and expiry.

## Testing

Extend snapshots for running turns with no hint, follow controls in short terminals, and copy status text at narrow widths and limited heights. Update resize assertions to check that the draft and caret remain stable relative to the terminal bottom.

head_commit.message:
Identify failed SQLite databases in `codex doctor` output (#47330)

## Why

The generic state integrity failure message does not identify which database needs attention.

## What changed

- Include the paths of all databases that fail integrity checks in a structured issue, shown in text summaries and JSON output, with the existing recovery guidance.
- Redact sensitive details using `: ` as the field-label separator so Windows drive letters are not mistaken for labels and unlabeled sensitive paths are fully redacted.

## Testing

Add coverage for single and multiple failed databases, summary and detailed text output, JSON output, preservation of damaged database contents, and sensitive path redaction on Unix and Windows.
